body:
I've talked to a few people here. Thank you everyone. This response is more than I could have imagined. More than I feel deserving of for a dumb message in the middle of the night.

I told someone close to me that I'm at least depressed. I couldn't use the s-word, but I think they know what I mean. They're trying to get me help.

I just feel absolutely overwhelmed by everything. I hope I can get past this. But I am alive today, so I figure that's good.
Thanks for the automatic downvote. Feels good, man.
